snippet.title: SpaceCorp: 2025-2300AD Official PC/Mac/iOS Trailer!
snippet.description:
This is the first trailer for the upcoming SpaceCorp: 2025-2300AD video game! SpaceCorp is a fast playing, turn-based, sci-fi strategy game playable in 45m or less! Players lead mandkind's first explorations into the solar system, building bases on the Moon and Mars, exploring the Rings of Saturn, and building colonies on Alpha Centauri.

It's a super fun turn-based game! Wishlist on Steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3728120/SpaceCorp_20252300AD/
